sourceContract: Claude Code hook JSON protocol (UserPromptSubmit: common fields with cwd, prompt), per code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks
author: otel-hook worktree-target owner (agent)
sanitization: Shape only. Every value is invented: ids are fabricated, file contents and commands are placeholders, and paths live under a fictional /workspace tree (contract-repo = the main checkout, contract-repo-slot-7 = a linked worktree) that tests rebase onto a temporary directory.
licenseBasis: Original synthetic authorship: field names reproduce a third-party tool's hook contract, all values are this repository's own.
notes: A prompt in a session started inside a linked worktree names that worktree as a session-cwd target, before the request it starts. The prompt text must not be exported. Exercised by tests/providers/worktree-target.test.ts.
